players.bio: A towering, incredibly hard-working, and goalscoring defensive midfielder. Souček is a hero for West Ham and the captain of the Czech national team, renowned for his aerial dominance.

players.name: David Douděra
players.bio: An incredibly energetic and fast right-sided player. Douděra can play as a full-back or winger, known for his relentless running and spectacular goals for Slavia Prague.

players.name: Michal Sadílek
players.bio: A diminutive but incredibly tenacious and aggressive central midfielder. Sadílek covers massive ground and is a key ball-winner for FC Twente.

players.name: Lukáš Provod
players.bio: A highly versatile, powerful, and technical midfielder with a lethal left foot. Provod overcame a serious injury to return as a star for Slavia Prague and the national team.

players.name: Pavel Šulc
players.bio: A brilliantly creative and goalscoring attacking midfielder. Šulc had an incredible breakout season, becoming one of the top scorers in the Czech league with Viktoria Plzeň.

players.name: Lukáš Červ
players.bio: A highly aggressive, passionate, and hard-tackling central midfielder. Červ is the engine room for Viktoria Plzeň, known for his relentless work rate.

players.name: Denis Višinský
players.bio: A brilliant young winger known for his speed, agility, and close control, making a name for himself at Slovan Liberec.

players.name: Alexandr Sojka
players.bio: A talented young midfielder developing in the Czech first division.

players.name: Hugo Sochůrek
players.bio: A highly promising young Czech talent.

players.name: Patrik Schick
players.bio: An incredibly elegant and lethal center-forward. Schick won the Euro 2020 Goal of the Tournament and was a key piece in Bayer Leverkusen's invincible double.

players.name: Tomáš Chorý
players.bio: A massive and incredibly physical target man. Chorý is an absolute nightmare for defenders in the air, dominating for Viktoria Plzeň before a controversial move to Slavia Prague.

players.name: Jan Kuchta
players.bio: A relentlessly hard-working, pressing center-forward. Kuchta won titles with both Slavia and Sparta Prague, known for his grit and crucial goals.

players.name: Adam Hložek
players.bio: A highly powerful and versatile forward. Hložek broke records at Sparta Prague as a teenager before winning the invincible double with Bayer Leverkusen.

players.name: Mojmír Chytil
players.bio: A strong, hard-working, and highly intelligent center-forward. Chytil excels at holding up the ball and linking play for Slavia Prague and the national team.

players.name: Dominik Livaković
players.bio: An incredibly agile and heroic goalkeeper. Livaković is a legend for Dinamo Zagreb and Croatia, famous for his phenomenal penalty saves at the 2022 World Cup.

players.name: Ivor Pandur
players.bio: A highly talented young Croatian goalkeeper who has played in Italy and the Netherlands.

players.name: Dominik Kotarski
players.bio: An incredibly commanding and ball-playing goalkeeper. Kotarski came through the Ajax academy before becoming a star for PAOK, winning the Greek championship.

players.name: Duje Ćaleta-Car
players.bio: A towering and physically dominant center-back. Ćaleta-Car is known for his aerial ability and passing range, playing in France, England, and for the Croatian national team.

players.name: Marin Pongračić
players.bio: A highly elegant, fast, and ball-playing center-back. Pongračić had a phenomenal season with Lecce in Serie A, earning a major transfer to Fiorentina.

players.name: Martin Erlic
players.bio: A robust, highly intelligent, and commanding center-back. Erlić built a fantastic reputation in Serie A with Spezia and Sassuolo before moving to Bologna.

players.name: Josip Stanišić
players.bio: An incredibly reliable and tactically versatile defender. Stanišić can play anywhere across the backline and was crucial to Bayer Leverkusen's invincible double.

players.name: Joško Gvardiol
players.bio: A physically imposing and technically gifted left-sided defender, Gvardiol is equally adept at center-back or left-back. He had a breakout World Cup before securing a mega-money move to Manchester City.

players.name: Josip Šutalo
players.bio: A highly elegant and technically gifted ball-playing center-back. Šutalo is the defensive leader for Croatia and secured a massive move to Ajax after dominating with Dinamo Zagreb.

players.name: Luka Vušković
players.bio: A generational defensive prodigy. Vušković is an incredibly dominant teenage center-back who broke records at Hajduk Split before Tottenham Hotspur secured his signature.

players.name: Luka Modrić
players.bio: A midfield maestro and one of the greatest playmakers in football history, Luka Modrić dictates the tempo of matches with his pristine passing and exceptional vision. He won the 2018 Ballon d'Or and has led Real Madrid to numerous Champions League titles.

players.name: Mateo Kovačić
players.bio: One of the most decorated and brilliantly press-resistant midfielders of his generation. Kovačić glides past opponents and has won four Champions League titles across Real Madrid and Chelsea.

players.name: Mario Pašalić
players.bio: An incredibly intelligent and goalscoring attacking midfielder. Pašalić is a master of late runs into the box and a crucial part of Atalanta's success, winning the Europa League.

players.name: Nikola Vlašić
players.bio: A powerful, dynamic, and direct attacking midfielder. Vlašić was the Russian Premier League Player of the Year before moving to West Ham and Torino.

players.name: Nikola Moro
players.bio: A highly technical and intelligent deep-lying playmaker. Moro pulls the strings in midfield for Bologna in Serie A.

players.name: Kristijan Jakić
players.bio: A relentlessly hard-working and aggressive defensive midfielder. Jakić was the engine room for Eintracht Frankfurt when they won the Europa League.

players.name: Luka Sučić
players.bio: A brilliantly elegant and creative left-footed attacking midfielder. Sučić possesses a phenomenal strike and vision, starring for RB Salzburg before moving to Real Sociedad.

players.name: Petar Sucic
players.bio: A highly dynamic and hard-working central midfielder. Sučić had an incredible breakout season with Dinamo Zagreb, breaking into the Croatian national team.

players.name: Martin Baturina
players.bio: A spectacular generational talent. Baturina is an incredibly creative, dribbling attacking midfielder hailed as the 'next Luka Modrić' at Dinamo Zagreb.

players.name: Toni Fruk
players.bio: A highly technical and creative attacking midfielder. Fruk had a phenomenal season leading the assist charts for Rijeka in the Croatian league.

players.name: Andrej Kramarić
players.bio: An absolute legend and the all-time top scorer for TSG Hoffenheim. Kramarić is a phenomenally clinical and intelligent forward who always finds the back of the net.

players.name: Ivan Perišić
players.bio: One of the greatest Croatian players in history. A relentlessly hard-working, two-footed winger who won the Champions League with Bayern and scored in a World Cup final.

players.name: Ante Budimir
players.bio: A towering and incredibly clinical target man. Budimir is a legend at Osasuna, known for his phenomenal heading ability and consistent goalscoring in La Liga.

players.name: Petar Musa
players.bio: A tall and powerful center-forward. Musa scored crucial goals for Benfica to win the Portuguese title before making a massive transfer to FC Dallas in MLS.

players.name: Marco Pašalić
players.bio: An incredibly explosive and direct winger with a devastating left foot. Pašalić revitalized his career at Rijeka, scoring spectacular long-range goals.

players.name: Igor Matanovic
players.bio: A massive, towering center-forward. Matanović had a phenomenal breakout season on loan at Karlsruher SC before returning to Eintracht Frankfurt as a key striker.

players.name: Mohammed Al Owais
players.bio: An incredibly agile and heroic goalkeeper. Al-Owais put on one of the greatest goalkeeping performances in World Cup history in Saudi Arabia's legendary victory over Argentina.

players.name: Nawaf Al Aqidi
players.bio: A highly talented young goalkeeper who broke through at Al-Nassr, establishing himself as a reliable shot-stopper behind a star-studded defense.

players.name: Ahmed Al Kassar
players.bio: An experienced Saudi goalkeeper who gained national attention for his heroic performances during the 2023 Asian Cup.

players.name: Abdulelah Al Amri
players.bio: A commanding and physically robust center-back. Al-Amri is a defensive pillar for Al-Nassr and the Saudi Arabian national team.

players.name: Saud Abdulhamid
players.bio: An incredibly fast, tireless, and dynamic right-back. Saud is the best Saudi player of his generation, winning everything with Al-Hilal before a historic move to Roma.

players.name: Ali Lajami
players.bio: A versatile and reliable defender capable of playing center-back or left-back. He is a key player for Al-Nassr.

players.name: Hassan Al Tambakti
players.bio: An incredibly composed, fast, and ball-playing center-back. Al-Tambakti was phenomenal against Argentina at the World Cup, earning a massive domestic transfer to Al-Hilal.

players.name: Hassan Kadesh
players.bio: A highly experienced left-back known for his defensive solidity and powerful left foot, playing for top clubs like Al-Hilal and Al-Ittihad.

players.name: Moteb Al Harbi
players.bio: An incredibly explosive and attacking left-back. Al-Harbi was the subject of a massive bidding war between Al-Nassr and Al-Hilal due to his phenomenal crossing ability.

players.name: Ali Majrashi
players.bio: A dynamic and fast right-back who has established himself as a starter for Al-Ahli.

players.name: Jehad Thakri
players.bio: A promising young Saudi defender.

players.name: Nawaf Boushal
players.bio: A reliable and quick right-back who secured a big move to Al-Nassr after impressing at Al-Fateh.

players.name: Salem Al Dawsari
players.bio: A legendary winger and arguably the greatest Saudi Arabian player of his generation. Famous for his spectacular winning goal against Argentina in the 2022 World Cup.

players.name: Abdullah Al Khaibari
players.bio: A combative and hard-working defensive midfielder. He is a crucial part of Al-Nassr's midfield, providing defensive cover for their star attackers.

players.name: Nasser Al Dawsari
players.bio: A versatile left-sided player who can operate as a left-back or central midfielder. He scored the fastest goal in AFC Champions League final history for Al-Hilal.

players.name: Ayman Yahya
players.bio: A highly talented and dynamic winger. He broke into the Al-Nassr first team as a teenager and has become an important attacking piece.

players.name: Musab Al Juwayr
players.bio: A brilliantly creative young midfielder. Considered one of the brightest prospects in Saudi football, developing at Al-Hilal.

players.name: Mohammed Kanno

players.name: Ziyad Al-Johani
players.bio: A highly energetic and hard-working central midfielder emerging at Al-Ahli.

players.name: Mohammed Abu Al Shamat
players.bio: A promising young Saudi right-back gaining experience in the domestic league.

players.name: Alaa Al Hejji
players.bio: An experienced Saudi midfielder playing in the Pro League.

players.name: Sultan Mandash
players.bio: A dynamic winger who has played for several top Saudi clubs, known for his pace and direct attacking style.

players.name: Saleh Al Shehri
players.bio: A clinical center-forward who famously scored Saudi Arabia's opening goal in their historic 2-1 victory over Argentina at the 2022 World Cup.

players.name: Abdullah Al-Hamdan
players.bio: A talented and hard-working forward. He broke through at Al-Shabab before securing a big move to Al-Hilal.

players.name: Khalid Al Ghannam
players.bio: An incredibly fast and tricky winger. He burst onto the scene with Al-Nassr and is considered one of the most exciting wide players in Saudi Arabia.

players.name: Firas Al Brikan
players.bio: A highly clinical and intelligent striker. Al-Brikan became the top Saudi goalscorer in the Pro League before a massive move to Al-Ahli.

players.name: Aymen Dahmen
players.bio: A heroic and highly experienced goalkeeper. Dahmen is the starting goalkeeper for the Tunisian national team, known for his spectacular reflexes.

players.name: Sabri Ben Hessen
players.bio: A reliable Tunisian goalkeeper currently playing in the domestic league.

players.name: Abdelmouhib Chamakh
players.bio: A developing Tunisian talent.

players.name: Dylan Bronn
players.bio: A robust and goalscoring center-back. Born in France but representing Tunisia, Bronn has extensive experience in France, Belgium, and Italy.

players.name: Ali El Abdi
players.bio: An incredibly attacking and prolific left-back. Abdi is known for scoring an unusually high number of goals from the fullback position in Ligue 2.

players.name: Yan Valery
players.bio: A highly athletic right-back who broke through at Southampton in the Premier League before moving to Angers and Sheffield Wednesday.

players.name: Mortadha Ben Ouanes
players.bio: A versatile left-sided player capable of playing as a full-back or winger. He has impressed in Turkey with Kasımpaşa.

players.name: Omar Rekik
players.bio: A highly technical, ball-playing center-back. The younger brother of Karim Rekik, Omar developed in the Arsenal academy before embarking on several loans.

players.name: Yassine Chikhaoui
players.bio: A Tunisian legend. An incredibly elegant and skillful attacking midfielder who starred for FC Zürich in Switzerland for many years.

players.name: Montassar Talbi
players.bio: A towering and commanding center-back. Talbi is the defensive rock for the Tunisian national team and has excelled for Lorient in Ligue 1.

players.name: Moutaz Neffati
players.bio: A promising young Tunisian defender.

players.name: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida
players.bio: An energetic left-back who has won numerous domestic and continental titles with Espérance Sportive de Tunis.

players.name: Adem Arous
players.bio: A talented young Tunisian midfielder.

players.name: Ellyes Skhiri
players.bio: A relentlessly hard-working and intelligent defensive midfielder. Skhiri covers immense ground, shining for Köln and Eintracht Frankfurt in the Bundesliga.

players.name: Rani Khedira
players.bio: A combative and highly reliable defensive midfielder. The younger brother of Sami Khedira, Rani is a crucial leader and captain for Union Berlin.

players.name: Anis Ben Slimane
players.bio: A physically imposing and technically gifted central midfielder. Ben Slimane won the Danish title with Brøndby before moving to Sheffield United in the Premier League.

players.name: Ismaël Gharbi
players.bio: A brilliantly talented and creative attacking midfielder. A product of the PSG academy, Gharbi shines with his dribbling and vision.

players.name: Hannibal Mejbri
players.bio: An incredibly passionate, tenacious, and creative midfielder. Mejbri broke through at Manchester United, known for his aggressive pressing and technical ability.

players.name: Elias Achouri
players.bio: A brilliantly fast, tricky, and direct winger. Achouri had a spectacular breakout season in Denmark, earning a major move to FC Copenhagen and starring in the Champions League.

players.name: Hadj Mahmoud
players.bio: A highly energetic and hard-working central midfielder. He impressed at Étoile du Sahel before moving to FC Lugano in Switzerland.

players.name: Sebastian Tounekti
players.bio: A young and versatile winger born in Norway who declared for Tunisia, playing in the Norwegian leagues.

players.name: Firas Chaouat
players.bio: A strong and clinical center-forward who has scored numerous goals for CS Sfaxien and played in Saudi Arabia and Egypt.

players.name: Elias Saad
players.bio: An incredibly fast, direct, and unpredictable winger. Saad had a spectacular rise from the German lower leagues to becoming a key player for FC St. Pauli.

players.name: Hazem Mastouri
players.bio: A hard-working Tunisian forward.

players.name: Rayan Elloumi
players.bio: A highly touted teenage prospect from Vasco da Gama's academy. Rayan is a powerful and direct forward with immense potential.

players.name: Khalil Ayari
players.bio: A developing young Tunisian player.

players.name: Mert Günok
players.bio: A towering and heroic goalkeeper. Günok made one of the greatest saves in European Championship history for Turkey at Euro 2024 and is a legend at Beşiktaş.

players.name: Altay Bayındır
players.bio: An incredibly tall and imposing goalkeeper. Bayındır starred for Fenerbahçe before securing a massive move to Manchester United.

players.name: Uğurcan Çakır
players.bio: A phenomenally agile and heroic goalkeeper. Çakır is the inspirational captain of Trabzonspor, leading them to a historic Süper Lig title.

players.name: Çağlar Söyüncü
players.bio: An incredibly aggressive, fast, and ball-playing center-back. Söyüncü became a fan favorite at Leicester City before moving to Atlético Madrid and Fenerbahçe.

players.name: Kaan Ayhan
players.bio: A brilliantly versatile and intelligent player. Ayhan can play center-back, right-back, or defensive midfield, scoring crucial goals for Galatasaray and Turkey.

players.name: Ferdi Kadıoğlu
players.bio: An incredibly dynamic, technical, and tireless full-back. Originally an attacking midfielder, Ferdi became one of the best attacking full-backs in Europe at Fenerbahçe before moving to Brighton.

players.name: Mert Müldür
players.bio: A highly athletic and versatile full-back. Müldür scored one of the goals of the tournament at Euro 2024 with a stunning volley for Turkey.

players.name: Zeki Çelik
players.bio: A robust, hard-working, and incredibly reliable right-back. Çelik was a crucial part of Lille's miraculous Ligue 1 title win before moving to AS Roma.

players.name: Abdülkerim Bardakcı
players.bio: A massive, powerful, and left-footed center-back. Bardakcı is known for his incredible passing range, strength, and goalscoring threat for Galatasaray.

players.name: Ozan Kabak
players.bio: A highly talented and aggressive center-back. Kabak played for massive clubs like Liverpool and Schalke before finding a home at Hoffenheim.

players.name: Merih Demiral
players.bio: An incredibly fierce, aggressive, and heroic center-back. Demiral is a warrior for Turkey, famously scoring two goals against Austria at Euro 2024.

players.name: Samet Akaydın
players.bio: A towering and physical center-back. Akaydin had a late rise to prominence, impressing for Adana Demirspor before moving to Fenerbahçe and Panathinaikos.

players.name: Evren Eren Elmalı
players.bio: A fast and highly attacking left-back. Elmalı had a breakout season with Kasımpaşa before securing a major move to Trabzonspor.

players.name: Salih Özcan
players.bio: A tremendously hard-working and aggressive defensive midfielder. Özcan breaks up play brilliantly and was a key player for Borussia Dortmund's run to the Champions League final.

players.name: Hakan Çalhanoğlu
players.bio: A phenomenal deep-lying playmaker and absolute master of free-kicks. Çalhanoğlu is the captain of Turkey and the heartbeat of Inter Milan's title-winning midfield.

players.name: Orkun Kökçü
players.bio: An incredibly creative, hard-working, and technically gifted central midfielder. Kökçü captained Feyenoord to the Eredivisie title before securing a massive move to Benfica.

players.name: İsmail Yüksek
players.bio: An incredibly energetic, combative, and relentless defensive midfielder. Yüksek covers immense ground and is a vital ball-winner for Fenerbahçe and Turkey.

players.name: Arda Guler
players.bio: A generational footballing prodigy. The 'Turkish Messi' possesses breathtaking vision, dribbling, and a magical left foot, earning a massive transfer to Real Madrid at just 18.

players.name: Oguz Aydin
players.bio: A brilliantly fast and highly productive winger. Aydın had an incredible breakout season with Alanyaspor, scoring and assisting for fun before moving to Fenerbahçe.

players.name: Baris Yilmaz
players.bio: An absolute physical monster on the wing. Yılmaz possesses incredible pace, strength, and work rate, terrifying defenders at Euro 2024 and starring for Galatasaray.

players.name: İrfan Kahveci
players.bio: A brilliantly gifted and spectacular attacking midfielder/winger. Kahveci has one of the best left feet in Europe, known for scoring unbelievable long-range goals for Fenerbahçe.

players.name: Yunus Akgün
players.bio: A highly tricky, creative, and fast winger. A product of the Galatasaray academy, Akgün starred on loan at Adana Demirspor and won promotion with Leicester City.

players.name: Muhammed Kerem Aktürkoğlu
players.bio: An incredibly fast, productive, and magical winger. Aktürkoğlu is a hero for Galatasaray, famously scoring against Manchester United, and secured a huge move to Benfica.

players.name: Deniz Gul
players.bio: A highly talented and physically imposing young center-forward. Gül broke through at Hammarby before securing a massive move to Porto.

players.name: Kenan Yıldız
players.bio: A phenomenal teenage superstar. Yıldız possesses incredible dribbling, flair, and an eye for the spectacular, breaking out as the new number 10 for Juventus and Turkey.

players.name: Can Uzun
players.bio: A breathtakingly talented teenage goalscorer. Uzun scored for fun in the 2. Bundesliga for Nürnberg before earning a massive move to Eintracht Frankfurt.

players.name: Edouard Mendy
players.bio: A phenomenally tall, agile, and commanding goalkeeper. Mendy had an incredible rise, winning the Champions League with Chelsea and the AFCON with Senegal.

players.name: Yehvann Diouf
players.bio: A highly agile and athletic goalkeeper. Diouf has established himself as one of the best young shot-stoppers in Ligue 1 with Stade de Reims.

players.name: Mory Diaw
players.bio: A towering and physically immense goalkeeper. Coming through the PSG academy, Diaw rebuilt his career in Switzerland before starring for Clermont Foot in Ligue 1.

players.name: Ismail Jakobs
players.bio: An incredibly fast, athletic, and direct left-back or winger. Jakobs starred for FC Köln before moving to Monaco and Galatasaray.

players.name: Kalidou Koulibaly
players.bio: A legendary, absolute mountain of a center-back. Koulibaly was one of the best defenders in the world at Napoli, captaining Senegal to AFCON glory.

players.name: Moussa Niakhaté
players.bio: A highly athletic, aggressive, and left-footed center-back. Niakhaté was the captain of Mainz 05 before moving to Nottingham Forest and Lyon.

players.name: Abdoulaye Seck
players.bio: A towering and physically dominant center-back. Seck won championships with Royal Antwerp and Maccabi Haifa, and the AFCON with Senegal.

players.name: Antoine Mendy
players.bio: A highly promising and athletic young defender. A product of the Nice academy, Mendy is breaking into the first team in Ligue 1.

players.name: Mamadou Sarr
players.bio: A towering and incredibly talented teenage center-back. Sarr came through the Lyon academy before making a significant transfer to Strasbourg.

players.name: El Hadji Diouf
players.bio: An absolute Senegalese legend and two-time African Footballer of the Year. Diouf terrified defenses at the 2002 World Cup and had a highly colorful career in the Premier League.

players.name: Pape Gueye
players.bio: A tall, elegant, and highly technical defensive midfielder. Gueye won the AFCON with Senegal and moved to Villarreal after a spell with Marseille.

players.name: Idrissa Gana Guèye
players.bio: An incredibly relentless, ball-winning defensive midfielder. Gueye is a Senegalese legend who starred for Everton, Aston Villa, and PSG.

players.name: Ismaïla Sarr
players.bio: A blisteringly fast and highly direct winger. Sarr was the hero who famously ended Liverpool's unbeaten run, starring for Watford, Marseille, and Crystal Palace.

players.name: Krépin Diatta
players.bio: An incredibly fast, hard-working, and versatile right-sided player. Diatta can play as a winger or wing-back, winning titles with Club Brugge before joining Monaco.

players.name: Pathé Ciss
players.bio: A physically imposing and hard-tackling defensive midfielder. Ciss established himself in Spain, playing a key role for Rayo Vallecano in La Liga.

players.name: Iliman Ndiaye
players.bio: A spectacularly gifted and magical dribbler. Ndiaye lit up the Championship with Sheffield United before moving to his boyhood club Marseille and then Everton.

players.name: Pape Sarr
players.bio: A phenomenally dynamic and energetic box-to-box midfielder. Sarr won the AFCON with Senegal and became a crucial, all-action player for Tottenham Hotspur.

players.name: Habib Diarra
players.bio: A brilliantly powerful and driving central midfielder. A product of the Strasbourg academy, Diarra is considered one of the best young talents in Ligue 1.

players.name: Lamine Camara
players.bio: A phenomenal midfield prodigy and African Young Player of the Year. Camara has incredible vision and shooting ability, shining for Metz before a major move to Monaco.

honours.title: African Young Player of the Year

players.name: Bara Sapoko Ndiaye
players.bio: A young Senegalese talent developing his career.

players.name: Sadio Mané
players.bio: A humble off the pitch but devastating on it, Mané is a legendary winger known for his explosive pace, pressing, and crucial goals. He led Senegal to their first-ever AFCON title.

players.name: Cherif Ndiaye
players.bio: A powerful and athletic center-forward. Ndiaye is known for his goalscoring exploits in Turkey and Serbia, notably for Red Star Belgrade.

players.name: Nicolas Jackson
players.bio: An incredibly fast, direct, and unpredictable striker. Jackson had a phenomenal breakout season at Villarreal before securing a massive transfer to Chelsea.

players.name: Ahmadou Bamba Dieng
players.bio: A highly explosive and fast forward. Dieng won the AFCON with Senegal and broke through at Marseille with his spectacular strikes before moving to Lorient.

players.name: Assane Diao
players.bio: An incredibly powerful and explosive teenage winger. Diao burst onto the scene with Real Betis, becoming one of the most exciting young talents in La Liga.

players.name: Ibrahim M'Baye
players.bio: A prodigious teenage winger. Mbaye made history as the youngest ever player to start a match for Paris Saint-Germain at just 16 years old.

players.name: Pape Thiaw
players.bio: A former Senegalese international striker who notably provided the backheel assist for Henri Camara's golden goal against Sweden at the 2002 World Cup.

players.name: Thibaut Courtois
players.bio: A towering and incredibly dominant goalkeeper, Courtois is famous for his astonishing reflexes and command of his penalty area. He was the hero of Real Madrid's 2022 Champions League triumph.

players.name: Senne Lammens
players.bio: A highly talented young Belgian goalkeeper. Lammens broke through at Club Brugge before moving to Royal Antwerp to establish himself as a starter.

players.name: Mike Penders
players.bio: An incredibly tall and highly rated teenage goalkeeper. Penders made history with Genk before Chelsea secured his signature in a massive transfer.

players.name: Timothy Castagne
players.bio: An incredibly tireless, athletic, and versatile full-back. Castagne can play on either flank and has starred for Atalanta, Leicester City, and Fulham.

players.name: Thomas Meunier
players.bio: A towering and incredibly attacking right-back. Originally a striker, Meunier is famous for his goals and crossing ability, winning titles with PSG and Club Brugge.

players.name: Brandon Mechele
players.bio: A fiercely loyal, no-nonsense center-back. Mechele is a true legend at Club Brugge, making hundreds of appearances and winning numerous Belgian titles.

players.name: Maxim De Cuyper
players.bio: An incredibly attacking and creative left-back. De Cuyper is known for his spectacular assists and goals, becoming a key player for Club Brugge and Belgium.

players.name: Arthur Theate
players.bio: An aggressive, fast, and ball-playing left-footed defender. Theate is known for his passion and defensive intensity, starring for Bologna and Rennes before moving to Eintracht Frankfurt.

players.name: Koni De Winter
players.bio: A towering and elegant young center-back. A product of the Juventus academy, De Winter has established himself as a reliable defender in Serie A with Genoa.

players.name: Zeno Debast
players.bio: An incredibly composed and technically gifted ball-playing center-back. Debast shone for Anderlecht before securing a massive transfer to Sporting CP.

players.name: Nathan Ngoy
players.bio: A fast, powerful, and highly promising young center-back developing at Standard Liège.

players.name: Joaquin Seys
players.bio: A highly talented and dynamic young left-back who broke into the Club Brugge first team and immediately impressed.

players.name: Kevin De Bruyne
players.bio: Widely regarded as one of the best midfielders of his generation, Kevin De Bruyne is a master of the final pass, possessing unmatched vision, crossing, and shooting ability. He has been the primary creative engine for Manchester City's dominance under Pep Guardiola.

players.name: Axel Witsel
players.bio: A legendary, incredibly composed, and tactically brilliant midfielder turned center-back. Witsel is a Belgian icon with over 130 caps, shining for Zenit, Dortmund, and Atlético Madrid.

players.name: Youri Tielemans
players.bio: A phenomenally gifted playmaker with an incredible long-range strike. Tielemans scored the spectacular winning goal in the 2021 FA Cup Final for Leicester City.

players.name: Dodi Lukebakio
players.bio: An incredibly fast, direct, and unpredictable left-footed winger. Lukebakio famously scored a hat-trick against Manuel Neuer and stars for Sevilla in La Liga.

players.name: Alexis Saelemaekers
players.bio: A tirelessly hard-working, versatile, and technically gifted wide player. Saelemaekers won Serie A with AC Milan and played a key role for Thiago Motta's Bologna.

players.name: Hans Vanaken
players.bio: An absolute legend of Belgian football. The incredibly tall, elegant, and goalscoring playmaker has won the Belgian Golden Shoe twice and is the ultimate icon of Club Brugge.

players.name: Nicolas Raskin
players.bio: A highly energetic, combative, and technical central midfielder. Raskin was the heartbeat of Standard Liège before moving to Rangers in Scotland.

players.name: Jeremy Doku
players.bio: Arguably the most explosive and devastating dribbler in world football. Doku possesses terrifying pace and agility, winning the Premier League with Manchester City.

players.name: Amadou Onana
players.fullName: Amadou Ba Zeund Georges Mvom Onana
players.bio: A massive, dominant, and incredibly athletic defensive midfielder. Onana is a physical monster who starred for Everton before a huge transfer to Aston Villa.

players.name: Diego Moreira
players.bio: A brilliantly fast and tricky winger. The son of Almani Moreira, Diego won the UEFA Youth League with Benfica before moving to Chelsea and Strasbourg.

players.name: Romelu Lukaku
players.bio: A powerful and prolific striker, Lukaku is Belgium's all-time top scorer. He uses his incredible strength and hold-up play to dominate defenders across Europe's top leagues.

players.name: Leandro Trossard
players.bio: An incredibly clinical, two-footed, and intelligent forward. Trossard is known for his clutch goals and phenomenal finishing ability for Arsenal.

players.name: Charles De Ketelaere
players.bio: A tall, elegant, and phenomenally gifted playmaker. De Ketelaere revitalized his career at Atalanta, winning the Europa League with his brilliant vision and goals.

players.name: Matias Fernandez-Pardo
players.bio: A highly exciting and clinical young forward. Fernandez-Pardo had an incredible breakout scoring run for Gent before securing a massive move to Lille.

players.name: Munir Mohamedi
players.bio: A highly experienced and heroic goalkeeper. Munir was the starting goalkeeper for Morocco at the 2018 World Cup and played a key role in their historic 2022 run.

players.name: Yassine Bounou
players.bio: A legendary, world-class goalkeeper known as 'Bono'. He won the Europa League with Sevilla and was the hero of Morocco's historic run to the 2022 World Cup semi-finals.

players.name: Ahmed Reda Tagnaouti
players.bio: A highly successful domestic goalkeeper who has won multiple Moroccan leagues and the CAF Champions League with Wydad AC.

players.name: Achraf Hakimi
players.bio: An elite attacking full-back, Hakimi boasts blistering speed and a winger's instinct in the final third. He was instrumental in Morocco's historic run to the 2022 World Cup semi-finals.

players.name: Noussair Mazraoui
players.bio: An incredibly technical and versatile full-back. Mazraoui won titles with Ajax and Bayern Munich before securing a massive move to Manchester United.

players.name: Issa Diop
players.bio: A massive, powerful, and commanding center-back. Diop was a prodigy at Toulouse before establishing himself as a reliable Premier League defender with West Ham and Fulham.

players.name: Nayef Aguerd
players.bio: A phenomenally elegant, left-footed, ball-playing center-back. Aguerd was a defensive rock for Morocco at the 2022 World Cup and won the Conference League with West Ham.

players.name: Anass Salah-Eddine
players.bio: A highly technical and attacking left-back. Coming through the Ajax academy, he has established himself as a starter for FC Twente.

players.name: Chadi Riad
players.bio: A highly promising, aggressive, and left-footed center-back. Riad impressed on loan at Real Betis from Barcelona, earning a major transfer to Crystal Palace.

players.name: Redouane Halhal
players.bio: A strong and talented young center-back who won the U23 AFCON with Morocco.

players.name: Zakaria El Ouahdi
players.bio: An incredibly fast and tireless right wing-back. El Ouahdi had a spectacular breakout season with Genk and won the U23 AFCON with Morocco.

players.name: Youssef Belammari
players.bio: A highly versatile and attacking full-back who won the Botola with Raja CA.

players.name: Sofyan Amrabat
players.bio: An absolute gladiator in midfield. Amrabat was the heart and soul of Morocco's incredible run to the 2022 World Cup semi-finals, known for his relentless tackling and stamina.

players.name: Brahim Diaz
players.bio: A spectacularly gifted, two-footed playmaker. Brahim has won league titles in England, Spain, and Italy, starring for AC Milan before returning to Real Madrid.

players.name: Azzedine Ounahi
players.bio: An incredibly elegant, silky, and technically gifted central midfielder. Ounahi was the breakout star of the 2022 World Cup, dazzling the world with his dribbling.

players.name: Ismael Saibari
players.bio: A phenomenally powerful and technically gifted attacking midfielder. Saibari is a key player for PSV Eindhoven, known for his driving runs and spectacular goals.

players.name: Neil El Aynaoui
players.bio: A highly intelligent, hard-working, and composed central midfielder. The son of tennis legend Younes El Aynaoui, Neil had an incredible breakout season with RC Lens.

players.name: Bilal El Khannouss
players.bio: A brilliantly creative teenage playmaker. El Khannouss won the Belgian Golden Shoe for Best Young Player before securing a major transfer to Leicester City.

players.name: Chemsdine Talbi
players.bio: A highly exciting and incredibly fast young winger breaking through at Club Brugge.

players.name: Ayyoub Bouaddi
players.bio: A generational midfield prodigy. Bouaddi made history as the youngest ever player to appear in a European club competition for Lille at just 16 years old.

players.name: Samir El Mourabet
players.bio: A promising young attacking midfielder developing his skills at Strasbourg.

players.name: Soufiane Rahimi
players.bio: An incredibly explosive and prolific forward. Rahimi won the AFC Champions League with Al-Ain, finishing as the top scorer and MVP of the tournament.

players.name: Ayoub El Kaabi
players.bio: A phenomenal and deeply instinctual goalscorer. El Kaabi scored an incredible 11 goals in the knockout stages to win the Conference League for Olympiacos.

players.name: Abdessamad Ezzalzouli
players.bio: Known as 'Abde'. A spectacularly tricky, fast, and unpredictable winger. He broke through at Barcelona before winning the Copa del Rey with Osasuna and moving to Real Betis.

players.name: Gessime Yassine
players.bio: A promising young winger developing his career at USL Dunkerque.

players.name: Ayoube Amaimouni-Echghouyab
players.bio: A highly technical young Moroccan player.

players.name: Alexander Schlager
players.bio: A highly agile and commanding goalkeeper. Schlager has been the number one for LASK and RB Salzburg, representing Austria at multiple major tournaments.

players.name: Patrick Pentz
players.bio: An incredibly brave and spectacular shot-stopper. Pentz had an incredible Euro 2024 for Austria and was a key player for Brøndby.

players.name: Florian Wiegele
players.bio: A promising young Austrian goalkeeper.

players.name: David Alaba
players.bio: A legendary, incredibly versatile defender and midfielder. Alaba has won numerous Champions League titles with Bayern Munich and Real Madrid, and is the captain and icon of the Austrian national team.

players.name: Stefan Posch
players.bio: A highly versatile and defensively solid right-back or center-back. Posch broke through at Hoffenheim before becoming a key figure in Thiago Motta's phenomenal Bologna team.

players.name: Philipp Mwene
players.bio: An energetic and hard-working full-back who can play on either side. Mwene is known for his overlapping runs and crossing ability for Mainz 05.

players.name: Kevin Danso
players.bio: A massive, powerful, and commanding center-back. Danso has established himself as one of the best defenders in Ligue 1, leading RC Lens to the Champions League.

players.name: Marco Friedl
players.bio: A highly composed, left-footed center-back and captain of Werder Bremen. A product of the Bayern Munich academy, Friedl has grown into a mature leader in the Bundesliga.

players.name: Philipp Lienhart
players.bio: An incredibly reliable and intelligent center-back. Lienhart, formerly of Real Madrid, has been the absolute defensive rock for SC Freiburg for many years.

players.name: Michael Svoboda
players.bio: A towering and physically dominant center-back. Svoboda had an incredible rise from the Austrian lower leagues to playing in Serie A with Venezia.

players.name: Alexander Prass
players.bio: A highly energetic, versatile, and technically gifted left-sided player. Prass shone for Sturm Graz before moving to Hoffenheim and starring for Austria at Euro 2024.

players.name: David Affengruber
players.bio: A robust and goal-scoring center-back. Affengruber was a key player for Sturm Graz, winning the Austrian Cup before moving to Spain.

players.name: Florian Grillitsch
players.bio: A highly intelligent, deep-lying playmaker who can also operate as a center-back. Grillitsch is known for his exceptional passing range and composure on the ball.

players.name: Alessandro Schöpf
players.bio: An energetic and versatile midfielder. Schöpf famously scored Austria's only goal at Euro 2016 and had a successful career in the Bundesliga before moving to MLS.

players.name: Konrad Laimer
players.bio: An absolute pressing machine. Laimer is renowned for his relentless energy, tackling, and incredible work rate, winning titles with RB Salzburg, RB Leipzig, and Bayern Munich.

players.name: Marcel Sabitzer
players.bio: A brilliantly dynamic and powerful goalscoring midfielder. Sabitzer was the captain of RB Leipzig and starred for Borussia Dortmund on their run to the Champions League final.

players.name: Xaver Schlager
players.bio: An incredibly tenacious, hard-working, and technically gifted central midfielder. Schlager is a key engine for RB Leipzig, known for his elite ball-winning and distribution.

players.name: Romano Schmid
players.bio: A diminutive, brilliantly creative, and agile attacking midfielder. Schmid is a key playmaker for Werder Bremen and scored a crucial goal for Austria at Euro 2024.

players.name: Christoph Baumgartner
players.bio: An incredibly dynamic, intelligent, and goalscoring attacking midfielder. Baumgartner scored the fastest goal in international football history (6 seconds) for Austria.

players.name: Nicolas  Seiwald
players.bio: A highly energetic and incredibly reliable defensive midfielder. Seiwald is a product of the Red Bull system, establishing himself at RB Leipzig with his elite pressing.

players.name: Patrick Wimmer
players.bio: An incredibly fast, powerful, and direct winger. Wimmer had a spectacular rise from the Austrian lower leagues to becoming a key attacker for Wolfsburg.

players.name: Carney Chukwuemeka
players.bio: A brilliantly talented, physically imposing, and elegant central midfielder. Born in Austria but representing England youth, Chukwuemeka broke through at Aston Villa before a major move to Chelsea.

players.name: Paul Wanner
